objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pull_request/push workflow received a deliberate decision and the required check (tests.yml) got exactly the working shape — no workflow-level paths/paths-ignore, salience computed in a step output and gating real work via `if:`, with no second workflow declaring the same check name, so no cap applies.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's paths/gate lists its own consumed inputs (deploy's src+deploy.sh, docs-site's docs+mkdocs.yml, tests' src/test/lockfiles) plus the workflow file itself rather than a catch-all or a copied sibling list, though a couple of path names can't be fully cross-verified against the tree.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule-only nightly-sweep and issue-driven triage workflows, the branch-protection ruleset, and all out-of-scope files were left untouched, and no documentation file was invented where none existed.
